task: Weapons + breakables + food pickups for Concrete Dragon
resume_brief: Build the ITEM/WEAPON layer for Concrete Dragon (~/workspace/ConcreteDragon). (1) WEAPONS (Final Fight style): pipe, bat, knife pickups — spawn from breakables/dropped enemies; pickup, swing attacks with limited durability, throwable; distinct feel per weapon. (2) BREAKABLES: barrels, crates, phone booths placed in districts — smash to spill cash/weapons/food. (3) FOOD/HEALTH pickups: heal items (turkey homage to Final Fight). Pull free/open-source: Kenney.nl prop/model packs where the style fits, else model simply in the game's blocky aesthetic. Branch weapons-items -> PR -> merge (never direct to main). Heartbeat ~/workspace/agent-ops/checkpoints/cd-weapons-items.json after every step; incremental commits. Verify with playtests + captures, your own eyes. Obvious-defect checklist every playtest.
summary: Weapons/items lane complete: pipe/bat/knife with durability/throw, barrel/phonebooth breakables, turkey. PR #25 merged.
